annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei n. 477/2024 - Tipifica na lei penal a alteração de fotos, vídeos e som com o uso de sistema de Inteligência Artificial para praticar violência contra a mulher
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 477/2024 - Criminalizes altering photos, videos and sound using AI systems to commit violence against women
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Saullo Vianna, União-AM)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill PL 477/2024 would amend the Penal Code to add Art. 216-C, criminalizing altering or manipulating photos, videos or sounds with AI to cause embarrassment, humiliation, harassment or violence against women in domestic or family settings, punishable by two to four years' imprisonment plus a fine.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds Art. 216-C to the Penal Code criminalizing AI-based manipulation of images, video or audio against women
Penalty of 2-4 years' reclusão and fine
Limited to domestic or family context
Justified as addressing AI-enabled gender-based violence and non-consensual content
